review.images: Seven native images from the named Serene brochure. Images show the wider community and shared podium settings. The outlook is a developer rendering and varies by unit.
review.location: The complete map artwork is shown from physical brochure page 30, excluding the facing title panel and any surrounding blank decoration. The three approximate journeys are published on the dedicated developer project page. Directions use the project name.
review.floorPlans: Fifteen full residence drawings from the original 64-page brochure. Pages 34, 38 and 54 were located from the visual page index because extracted room labels did not identify them. Visible headings and saleable area panels were checked on all fifteen. Key plans remain in the brochure.
